purpose: Separate what kind of source or claim is being presented from how reliable it is or whether it proves a farm-specific outcome.

official_program_guidance.label: Official rule or programme guidance
official_program_guidance.boundary: Describes a published government rule, programme or operational direction. Confirm current edition, jurisdiction, adoption and case-specific applicability.

official_regulatory_advisory.label: Official regulatory advisory
official_regulatory_advisory.boundary: A regulator's published advisory that explains its position; it is not individualized legal advice or confirmation of the correct filing category for a specific business.

official_administrative_listing.label: Official administrative listing
official_administrative_listing.boundary: An agency directory or contact listing. It does not confirm current hours, availability, emergency response or service coverage.

official_technical_guidance.label: Official or dairy-sector technical guidance
official_technical_guidance.boundary: Educational husbandry, health, nutrition or production guidance. It is not an individualized prescription or proof of local results.

official_breed_registry.label: Official breed registry
official_breed_registry.boundary: Identifies registered breed names and associated registry information; it does not verify an individual animal's identity, performance or availability.

official_agricultural_advisory.label: Official agricultural advisory
official_agricultural_advisory.boundary: General crop or seasonal advisory. Local variety, planting window, irrigation and yield require local extension and plot evidence.

research_institute_profile.label: Research institute profile
research_institute_profile.boundary: An institutional breed or technical profile; reported population traits and historical averages are not guarantees for an individual animal.

historical_statistic_or_observation.label: Historical statistic or observation
historical_statistic_or_observation.boundary: A dated census, district statistic, weather observation or historical series. It describes its stated period and geography, not today's local condition.

official_weather_information.label: Official weather information
official_weather_information.boundary: Definitions or current operational weather information; check live local alerts and inspect the actual parcel.

market_context_not_producer_price.label: Market context, not a farm-gate price
market_context_not_producer_price.boundary: Consumer or general market context cannot be used as a milk procurement rate or farm revenue input.

established_fact.label: Established fact
established_fact.boundary: A narrowly scoped statement verified from a current authoritative record or source passage. The citation must support the exact statement; an authoritative publisher alone is not enough.

research_finding.label: Research finding
research_finding.boundary: A reported study result with its population, method, date and limitations preserved; do not generalize beyond the study.

historical_statistic_or_observation.label: Historical statistic or observation
historical_statistic_or_observation.boundary: A dated measurement or dataset result. Preserve period and geography; do not present it as current conditions.

farmer_or_seller_report.label: Farmer or seller report
farmer_or_seller_report.boundary: Attribute the speaker and date; distinguish recollection from documents and direct observation. No local interviews or seller claims are collected in this guide.

model_assumption_or_calculated_output.label: Model assumption or calculated output
model_assumption_or_calculated_output.boundary: A user-entered scenario or result derived from entered assumptions; it is not an observed price, yield, profit or forecast.

unverified_local_claim.label: Unverified local claim
unverified_local_claim.boundary: A local proposition without current direct confirmation; show the missing evidence and do not present it as established fact.

professional_veterinary_judgment.label: Professional veterinary judgment
professional_veterinary_judgment.boundary: A case-specific opinion from a qualified veterinary professional with date and scope recorded. No local veterinary approval of this guide is claimed.

physical_inspection.label: Physical inspection required
physical_inspection.boundary: An animal, land, facility, water, drainage or equipment condition that must be observed or measured in person. No farm parcel or animal has been inspected for this guide.

classification_limit: Source class describes the source form, not evidence quality, passage-level support, truth, recency or applicability. Each substantive claim still needs its own scope, exact source passage, limitations and review.
